db_uri.description: Database connection URI (e.g., sqlite, PostgreSQL, MySQL). Default is SQLite for standalone instances.

debug.description: Enable detailed error pages and debug logging. Disable in production.

git_folder.description: Absolute path to the directory where Git repositories are stored.

docs_folder.description: Absolute path to directory for rendered documentation (e.g., HTML versions of READMEs).

attachments_folder.description: Absolute path to directory for user-uploaded attachments (issues, PRs, etc.).

avatars_folder.description: Absolute path to directory for user and project avatar images.

ssh_keydir.description: Directory where Pagure writes SSH public keys for Git access control.

hooks_dir.description: Directory containing Git hooks used by Pagure for integration (e.g., webhooks).

email_templates_dir.description: Directory with Jinja2 templates for email notifications.

static_folder.description: Directory containing static assets (CSS, JS, images) served by Pagure.

template_folder.description: Directory with Jinja2 templates for the web UI.

static_url_path.description: URL prefix under which static assets are served (must begin and end with '/').

pagure_url.description: Public-facing URL of the Pagure instance (e.g., https://pagure.example.com/). Required for email links and redirects.

host.description: IP address to bind the internal Flask server to (e.g., 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces).

port.description: Port number for the internal Flask server.

use_ssl.description: When behind a reverse proxy with HTTPS, set to true to force secure scheme.

items_per_page.description: Default number of items (issues, PRs, commits) per page in paginated views.

request_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for outgoing HTTP requests (e.g., webhooks, email SMTP).

git_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for Git operations (clone, fetch, push).

email_require_confirmation.description: Require new users to confirm email address before full access.

git_anonymous_clone.description: Allow anonymous Git clone (read-only) for public projects.

git_http.description: Enable Git operations over HTTP (GET/POST). Usually disabled; use SSH or Git over HTTPS instead.

git_ssh.description: Enable Git operations over SSH (push/pull via ssh:// or git@host).

git_http_auth.description: Require authentication for Git HTTP operations (e.g., using basic auth headers).

git_hooks_enabled.description: List of Git hook names to enable by default on all new repositories.

email_domain_whitelist.description: List of allowed email domains for registration (e.g., ['example.com']). Empty = allow any domain.

email_domain_blacklist.description: List of blocked email domains (e.g., for disposable providers like 'tempmail.com').

mail_server.description: SMTP server hostname for sending email notifications (required for email alerts).

mail_use_tls.description: Whether to use STARTTLS when connecting to the SMTP server.

mail_use_ssl.description: Whether to use SSL when connecting to the SMTP server.

mail_default_sender.description: Email address used as sender for Pagure-generated emails.

ldap_uid_field.description: LDAP attribute to use as the username.

ldap_email_field.description: LDAP attribute to use for the user email address.

ldap_binddn.description: Bind DN for service account (optional, for read access to LDAP directory).

oauth_providers.description: List of OAuth2 providers to integrate (e.g., GitHub, GitLab).

redis_url.description: Redis connection URL for caching and async tasks (e.g., 'redis://localhost:6379/0').

webhook_delivery_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for each webhook delivery attempt.

notifications_on.description: Enable email notifications for activity in projects and issues.

notify_on_new_issue.description: Send notifications on new issue/PR creation (not just updates).

reauth_require.description: Require re-authentication for sensitive actions (e.g., delete project).

custom_footer.description: Custom HTML to render in the page footer (e.g., copyright, links).

project_readme_mandatory.description: Require projects to include a README.md upon creation.

git_default_branch.description: Default branch name for new repositories.

branch_protection.description: Enable branch protection rules (e.g., require PR to merge to protected branches).

default_group.description: Default group assigned to new projects (if project creation is restricted to groups).

tokens_enabled.description: Enable API tokens for authenticating with CLI tools and scripts.

token_expiry.description: Token expiration time in seconds (0 = never expire).

rate_limit.description: Rate limit for general API/web requests: [max_requests, window_seconds].

plugins_enabled.description: Enable plugin system (requires plugins to be installed).

enabled_plugins.description: List of plugin names to load (e.g., ['pagure_ci', 'pagure_hook_deploy']).

timeline_enabled.description: Enable activity timeline (e.g., commit history, issue updates).

dependencies_enabled.description: Enable issue/PR dependency tracking (e.g., blocks, related to).

cc_enabled.description: Enable CC list for issue/PR notifications.

milestone_due_dates.description: Allow setting due dates on milestones.

allow_user_avatar.description: Allow users to upload custom avatars.

gravatar_fallback.description: Fall back to Gravatar if no custom avatar exists.

email_digests_enabled.description: Enable daily/weekly email digests of project activity.

project_create.description: Allow regular users to create new projects.

project_private.description: Allow projects to be private (restricted access).

group_create.description: Allow regular users to create groups.

private_project_require_group.description: Require group membership to view private projects (bypasses user access).

project_transfer.description: Allow users to transfer project ownership.

project_delete.description: Allow users to delete their projects.

issue_soft_delete.description: Mark issues as deleted (soft delete) instead of hard-deleting.

two_factor_auth.description: Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) for all users.

oidc_discovery.description: Enable automatic OIDC provider discovery using metadata URL.

maintenance_message.description: Custom message to display during maintenance.

x_frame_options.description: X-Frame-Options header value to prevent clickjacking.

session_cookie_http_only.description: Prevent JavaScript access to session cookies.

login_rate_limit.description: Enable rate limiting for login attempts.

login_rate_limit_window.description: Rate limit window in seconds (e.g., 300 = 5 min).

password_require_upper.description: Require at least one uppercase letter.

password_require_lower.description: Require at least one lowercase letter.

password_require_special.description: Require at least one special character.

email_verification_on_reset.description: Require email verification before password reset.

password_reuse_check.description: Check password history to prevent reuse.

password_reuse_count.description: Number of previous passwords to remember.

account_lockout.description: Lock account after failed login attempts.

password_expiry_warning_days.description: Days before expiry to warn user.

password_history_count.description: Number of previous passwords to store.

password_self_service.description: Allow users to change their own passwords.

account_self_delete.description: Allow users to delete their own accounts.

account_delete_email.description: Send email notification on account deletion.

project_delete_archive.description: Archive project data instead of deleting it on project deletion.

audit_log.description: Enable audit logging (who did what, when).

activity_log.description: Log user and system activity (e.g., pushes, issue updates).

log_ip_address.description: Include client IP address in logs.

log_user_agent.description: Include user agent string in logs.

log_rotate_max_bytes.description: Max log file size before rotation (bytes).

log_rotate_backup_count.description: Number of rotated log files to retain.
